El modo normal no comparte guardados con: Normal mode doesn't share saves with Mods Mode. The first launch creates a copy of your current progress, and from then on they advance separately.
MODS MODE ENABLED · Restart the game. Test only with a copy of your save. Experimental mode doesn't guarantee the game will accept every item.
RAD100K — intenta sumar 100.000 de diner: RAD100K — tries to add 100,000 of the game's real money. The cents conversion and the artificial 9,999.99 cap were fixed. If the game keeps its own internal cap, it won't be bypassed.
Corrección experimental: al cargar, Modo: Experimental fix: when loading, Mods Mode accepts extra Master Balls without altering the save's general verifiers. Try it only with a backup and don't save if any other anomaly appears.
RADITEM + ID + X + cantidad (máximo 99);: RADITEM + ID + X + quantity (max 99); common items and Poké Balls only. These commands are only available inside Mods Mode.
Buscá un Pokémon o un objeto, consultá s: Search for a Pokémon or an item, look up its number and tap “Use ID” to load it automatically into the generator. Works without an internet connection.
RADITEM funciona solo con objetos permit: RADITEM only works with items the game allows, and only in Mods Mode. IDs without a confirmed name may be invalid. A copied code does not give the item until you enter it in F3.
1. Cerrá el juego y tocá «Crear copia de: 1. Close the game and tap “Create backup” below. 2. Enable “Use separate save” and “On-screen F3 button”. 3. Start or restart Pokémon Reloaded. 4. While exploring, tap F3, type the code you copied here and confirm with Enter/OK. Some codes don't work in battles, menus or dialogues. 5. Test the result. Save, close and reload experimental mode to check it.
Si copiás un código, tenés que introduci: If you copy a code, you must enter it in the F3 box inside the game: the copy button doesn't run the cheat by itself. If “Corruption” or “Anomaly” appears, do NOT save; exit and restore the backup.
En Modo Mods se admiten capturas adelant: Mods Mode allows early captures of the species in the event catalog, including Cosmog, even if you haven't completed its quest yet. This doesn't complete badges, quests or events for you and doesn't affect Normal Mode. Save and inventory integrity checks are kept.
Si antes tenías «Corrupción J100E980» u: If you previously had “Corruption J100E980” or another J…E… because of an early capture, try loading the same slot from Mods Mode. Make a backup first. Don't save if a different anomaly appears.
Elegí el ID INTERNO de la especie (buscá: Choose the species' INTERNAL ID (search by name in “Pokémon IDs”) and the level. Mods Mode prepares an encounter so you can catch it with the game's original functions, without directly editing your team or boxes.
Requiere Modo Mods y F3 activados. Al ex: Requires Mods Mode and F3 enabled. While exploring, enter the code in F3 to start an encounter and catch it normally. Format: RADPK980X10 for a level 10 Cosmog. Use the letter X, no spaces. Don't save if an anomaly appears.
Los NTV son los valores naturales de cad: NTVs are each Pokémon's natural values; they are not training IVs. In Reloaded the six NTVs range from 1 to 10. Here we raise them using the game's original function, which also updates the internal checks. It does not directly modify the .savc file.
Ejemplo: RADNV1X6 aumenta un punto la Ve: Example: RADNV1X6 raises the first Pokémon's natural Speed by one point. RADMX1 sets all six NTVs of the first Pokémon to the maximum. If it is already at maximum, nothing happens. The position is the team slot, NOT the box.
La opción shiny del encuentro afecta al: The encounter's shiny option affects the new wild Pokémon; it doesn't transform one on your team. To convert an existing one, Reloaded includes the Shinifier Machine: once you meet the story requirements, type SHINY in F3 to get that save's password, and use it on the machine.
Los caramelos de experiencia de Pokémon: Pokémon Reloaded's experience candies raise friendship when you use them on a Pokémon. This option generates the item with the game's inventory routine: it doesn't modify hidden save values. They also grant experience. Exp. Candy XS = ID 683.
Pasos: 1) ejecutá el código con F3; 2) a: Steps: 1) run the code with F3; 2) open the bag; 3) use the Exp. Candies XS on the chosen Pokémon; 4) check friendship in the game. It does not set maximum friendship instantly, and the cheat only works if the game accepts that item through RADITEM.
Los IV de entrenamiento (0–9) son distin: Training IVs (0–9) are different from NTVs. In Reloaded they improve by training or using vitamins. You can try RADITEM36X5 to get 5 Protein (Attack), RADITEM33X5 for Calcium (Sp. Atk) or RADITEM37X5 for Zinc (Sp. Def). Then use those items normally from the bag. Don't confuse IVs with NTVs.
La versión anterior producía la anomalía: The previous version produced anomaly 10551 when running item actions from F3. This version uses the original player context and doesn't disable inventory or money validation. Don't save if any anomaly warning appears.
